name: B10-0244/2026 – After § 17 – Am 7
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need to reduce work-related fatalities
part_text: 17a. Calls, in particular, for labour inspectorate staffing to go beyond the benchmark of one inspector per 10 000 workers and move towards one per 5 000 workers, and for labour inspectorate staffing to be given effective powers, such as the power to order immediate work interruption in cases of serious and imminent danger, including extreme heat; calls on the Commission to support these objectives by publishing a recommendation and through regular reporting on implementation;
